description: This file defines classes for configuring NATS streaming within an Orleans server environment, including settings for service configuration, caching, and partitioning.

classes.name: SiloNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for NATS streaming in Orleans silos, allowing service configuration, cache, and partitioning adjustments.

classes.name: ClusterClientNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for NATS streaming in Orleans cluster clients, enabling NATS options and partitioning setup.

methods.name: ConfigureNats
methods.description: Configures NATS options for the respective configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Sets cache size for the silo NATS stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Sets the number of queues for partitioning.
